title: Matthew Bible Quiz - Chapter 17
description: Ten questions on Matthew 17: the change on the high mountain, the voice from the cloud, a boy cured, and a coin in a fish's mouth.

questions.text: Which three disciples did Jesus take up into a high mountain by themselves?
questions.explanation: After six days Jesus took with him Peter, James, and John his brother, and brought them up into a high mountain by themselves.

questions.text: What happened to Jesus' face when he was changed before them?
questions.explanation: He was changed before them: his face shone like the sun, and his garments became as white as the light.

answers.text: It was hidden by a cloud
It was veiled with a cloth

questions.text: Who appeared and talked with him on the mountain?
questions.explanation: Moses and Elijah appeared to them, talking with him.

questions.text: What did Peter offer to make there?
questions.explanation: Peter said it was good for them to be there and offered to make three tents: one for Jesus, one for Moses, and one for Elijah.

answers.text: A seat for each of them

questions.text: What did the voice out of the bright cloud say?
questions.explanation: A voice came out of the cloud saying that this was his beloved Son, in whom he was well pleased, and telling them to listen to him.

answers.text: That the Kingdom had come near
That this was his beloved Son; listen to him
That the prophets had spoken truly
That Moses and Elijah were servants

questions.text: What did Jesus command the disciples as they came down from the mountain?
questions.explanation: Jesus commanded them not to tell anyone what they had seen until the Son of Man had risen from the dead.

answers.text: To tell no one what they had seen
To go first to the scribes in Jerusalem
To build an altar on the mountain
To fast for six days in Galilee

questions.text: Whom did the disciples understand Jesus was speaking about when he said Elijah had come already?
questions.explanation: Then the disciples understood that he spoke to them of John the Baptizer.

questions.text: What did the kneeling man say was wrong with his son?
questions.explanation: The man asked for mercy on his son, saying the boy was epileptic and suffered grievously, often falling into the fire and into the water.

answers.text: He was blind from his birth
He was deaf and could not speak
He was lame and could not walk
He was epileptic and suffered grievously

questions.text: Why did Jesus say the disciples had not been able to cast it out?
questions.explanation: When they asked privately why they could not do it, he said it was because of their unbelief.

answers.text: Because the hour had not yet come

questions.text: What did Jesus tell Peter he would find in the mouth of the first fish he caught?
questions.explanation: Jesus told him to cast a hook into the sea and open the mouth of the first fish, where he would find a stater coin to give for them both.
